when: the request passes the role, the justification and the code (outcome SHOWN)
reason: The entry's words and its bond-day's date are shown in the POST's own response, never cached. The read is one ENTRY_TEXT_READ row (SUCCEEDED) and one WORDS_READ row in the report's log, committed with it; the report stays open. A MODERATOR or SUPPORT never reaches this, a wrong code is the form again with nothing read, and every read needs a new code.
evidenceRef: ContentAccessServiceTest#shown writes one ENTRY_TEXT_READ row and the report's WORDS_READ row

reason: No words: the page says its author erased the entry. The read is still audited (SUCCEEDED) and still logs WORDS_READ, because the act completed and read nothing. An open report does not hold the words from their author's erasure or withdrawal.
evidenceRef: ContentAccessServiceTest#an erased entry is SUCCEEDED, read nothing, and is logged WORDS_READ

reason: Nothing is read: the report's page says it was already decided. The attempt is one ENTRY_TEXT_READ row (REFUSED) and no WORDS_READ row; the report is never read once decided. Not this row: a well-formed id that names no report. The port answers NOT_OPEN for it too, but only after the code has been proved and spent; the attempt is one ENTRY_TEXT_READ row (REFUSED) on the REPORT target, and the answer is the 404 page, since there is no report to show.
evidenceRef: ContentAccessServiceTest#each refusal is REFUSED on its target and logs no WORDS_READ

when: the reason the page showed is not the report's reason now (outcome STALE)
reason: Nothing is read: someone reclassified the report after the page was loaded, so the admin is told to read it again. One ENTRY_TEXT_READ row (REFUSED), no WORDS_READ row.
evidenceRef: ContentAccessServiceTest#each refusal is REFUSED on its target and logs no WORDS_READ

when: a member report, or a report whose reason is NON_CONSENSUAL or MINOR_SEXUAL_CONTENT (outcome NOT_ABOUT_WORDS)
reason: Nothing is read: the page says why (a member report has no entry; an image reason is reclassified first if its detail is about words). This keeps a read off any report that might concern child sexual abuse material. One ENTRY_TEXT_READ row (REFUSED), no WORDS_READ row.
evidenceRef: ContentAccessServiceTest#each refusal is REFUSED on its target and logs no WORDS_READ

when: at any time while the report is open
reason: The author's right to erase wins: an open report does not hold the words. A withdrawn author's entry reads as erased even before the outbox has emptied the row, so that the admin does not read what the partner can no longer read.
evidenceRef: ReportedEntryTextTest#an entry its author erased is erased, and the read is still logged

when: dismissed, reclassified-and-upheld or upheld by a moderator or an admin (A2)
reason: From then on no one may read its words: the rule needs an OPEN report.
evidenceRef: ReportedEntryTextTest#a report decided first is not open, and nothing is logged

when: a moderator or an admin picks NON_CONSENSUAL or MINOR_SEXUAL_CONTENT (A2)
reason: The reason decides: an image reason is never read as words, whatever its detail.

when: a report on an entry, whose detail shows it is about words (A2)
reason: Reclassified first, then read: the one way an image-reason report's entry is ever read.
evidenceRef: ReportedEntryTextTest#an image reason reclassified to one about words is then shown
